title: Release shipped, CHANGELOG never updated
author: nisaba
description: Compares GitHub releases against this project's own CHANGELOG.md entries by exact tag match, and surfaces a release with no matching changelog entry as the seam gap. The reference recipe: copy this directory's shape for a new one.
confidence_notes: Fixed 0.80 for a release with no exact-tag match in the changelog fixture — a tag-match miss is a strong, unambiguous signal (no keyword fuzziness to misfire on), so a flat score above CONFIDENCE_BAR (0.70) is honest, not inflated. A matched release is excluded at confidence 0.0, named, not hidden, the same as scan.py's excluded list. This fixture surfaces exactly one candidate, so ranking.py's separation_margin (0.15) is trivially clear against an empty tail.
